assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The pass attempts the launch despite a binding stopped-run claim, which is exactly what restoring the removed pre-check does; the negative control shows this arm reddening at EXIT=1 with four attempts.
The claim releases (holder pointer removed) but the request is not launched on the next pass, which fails if the hold is sticky rather than recomputed per pass.

A CompetenceLimit request is retried on the timer instead of held; the two passes at now+2h would each add an attempt, so reverting _until_changed_hold makes probe.attempted grow and the assertion fail.
The plan stamp moves but the request is not retried, which fails if the guard comparison at queue_admission.py:949 is inverted or the guard is never stored.
retry_at is not exactly one back-off after failure_at, which fails if _record_queued_failure is handed the pass start again.
The back-off is measured from the injected 2020 pass start, which fails the >365-day comparison if moment=moment is restored.
More than one of the four requests reaches the launch; this is the arm the declared negative control reddens.

findings.text: blocking: _UNTIL_CHANGED_FAILURES matches the substring 'node is not dispatchable', which reckon/crew/summary.py:486 also uses for a capacity refusal (backend at its partition-cores or login-memory bound, raised from reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:275-282 and cured by an occupying run finishing). _dependency_guard at line 725 fingerprints only brief, plan, host-config, project-config and code, none of which moves when a run finishes, so a request refused for capacity is now held-until-changed indefinitely where the old bounded back-off retried it - the stranding this section exists to remove, reintroduced for a second refusal class.

blocking: section 32's done-when requires that the test files importing reckon.crew.queue_admission add no failures against the base revision, but this neighbour passes at base 1211c30e8b (logs/overlapping-base.log, 10 passed 1 failed) and fails at head b7cbbbc4 (logs/admission-neighbours-head.log, 35 passed 2 failed; logs/overlapping-head-single.log reddens the same test alone) because it asserts the ScopeConflict failure and retry_at this section replaces. The worker reported it under outside_scope rather than repairing it, and its write grant omitted the file that had to move with the change.

non-blocking: _declared_scope_paths duplicates the capability owned by reckon/crew/runs.py:1019 _repository_relative_scope (normalize an in-repository scope to a repository-relative POSIX path); it is a deliberate variant because it does not resolve symlinks, but extending the owner with a resolve=False argument would keep one normalizer in the repository.
